kind.instructions: What kind of work does this task describe?

criteria.ship: Implement, fix, or change code to deliver something.
criteria.scout: Explore, investigate, or research without changing code yet.
criteria.review: Review someone else's change and give feedback.
criteria.architecture: Design a system, decide trade-offs, write an RFC or proposal.
criteria.admin: Chores: cleanup, releases, dependencies, routine maintenance.

difficulty.instructions: How difficult is this task for a capable engineer?

criteria.easy: Small, well-scoped, under an hour: typo, rename, single-file tweak.
criteria.medium: A focused change touching a few files, normal feature or fix.
criteria.hard: Large, ambiguous, or risky: migration, rewrite, cross-service refactor.

surface.instructions: Which part of the codebase does this task touch?

criteria.frontend: UI, pages, components, styles, client rendering.
criteria.mixed: More than one of the above, or no clear single surface.

reasoningClass.instructions: What kind of reasoning does this task need?

criteria.code-gen: Write new code or extend existing code.
criteria.debug: Diagnose a failure: error, bug, crash, failing test.
criteria.review: Read and judge a change made by someone else.

riskClass.instructions: What is the blast radius if this task is done wrong?

criteria.low: Cosmetic or fully reversible: typo, comment, rename.
criteria.medium: Normal change with tests and review as the safety net.
criteria.high: Production data, auth, payments, migrations, irreversible actions.

toolAffinity.instructions: Which tool family would do most of this task?

criteria.browser: Needs a browser: pages, clicks, visual checks.
criteria.shell: Needs a shell: scripts, servers, deploys, CI, CLIs.
criteria.git: Mostly version control: merges, rebases, branches, PRs.
criteria.none: No tool family dominates; plain reasoning or prose.
